ACCESS: saksfifthavenue.com is DataDome-protected. Direct HTTP fetch (curl) -> 403 (779-byte block body) on both / and /robots.txt, matching prior Home-Decor pass. curl_cffi impersonation across 6 fresh profiles (chrome120/124/131, safari17_0, firefox135, chrome99_android) -> 403 with byte-identical 782-byte DataDome block body on every profile. Headless Playwright (chromium, spoofed Chrome UA) -> also 403 with the DataDome challenge page. Escalated to Claude-in-Chrome (tier 3) per brief: robots.txt (per prior pass's Wayback-CDX-verified content, referenced only for the site-structure fact, not as a fetch substitute) names ~90 bots with blanket Disallow but NO ClaudeBot/Claude-User/Claude-SearchBot/Claude-Web/anthropic-ai entry, so no Claude-specific block applies. In the real (non-headless, extension-driven) Chrome session, DataDome passed automatically (no CAPTCHA was presented or solved by me) after a few seconds and normal site browsing became possible.

ABSENCE PROOF (checked real navigation, not just search, per Rule 4): (1) Main site nav bar (15 top-level departments): Women, Men, Designers, New, Clothing, Dresses, Shoes, Bags, Jewelry, Accessories, Beauty, Kids, Home, Sale, What to Wear -- no Pets/Pet Shop department. (2) Home department's own Category refine list (https://www.saksfifthavenue.com/c/home, 4,640 items): Holiday & Christmas, Kitchen, Home Decor, Bedding, Dining & Entertaining, Best Sellers, Luggage & Travel Gear, Household Tech, Bath, Home Storage & Jewelry Boxes, Lighting -- no Pets. (3) Home Decor subcategory list (https://www.saksfifthavenue.com/c/home/home-decor, 1,993 items): Accent Furniture & Rugs, Books, Bowls/Vases & Trays, Candles & Diffusers, Decorative Pillows, Games & Entertainment, Home Accents, Picture Frames, Plants and Flowers, Wall Decor & Mirrors -- no Pets, and the Home Accents catch-all subcategory (280 items) sample-browsed with no pet items visible. (4) /c/home/pets returns a 200 that silently redirects to the site homepage (not a valid slug). Site search for 'pet', 'pet bed', and 'pet carrier' all returned the IDENTICAL 3-item result set (ROYCE New York Leather Dog Leash $200, Jonathan Adler Vice Meow Pet Bowl $125, ROYCE New York Small Leather Dog Collar $120) -- a non-discriminating/flat-fallback search per this project's known false-absence pattern, so search alone was NOT relied on for the absence conclusion. 'dog' search (29 items) is almost entirely dog-THEMED jewelry/apparel/figurines/books/sunglasses (excluded per Tier boundary: pet-themed != pet care), plus the same leash and a Dolce&Gabbana dog fragrance mist. 'cat' search (292 items) is overwhelmingly 'cat-eye sunglasses' noise.

CONCLUSION: Saks Fifth Avenue / Saks Home has no dedicated Pet Care department, category, or sub-category anywhere in its taxonomy. The handful of pet-adjacent SKUs that exist (a leather dog leash, a leather dog collar, a Jonathan Adler cat-themed pet bowl, a dog fragrance) are individually catalogued one-off products scattered inside generic Home/Accessories buckets with no dedicated PLP/category URL -- per Rule 4 this is PLP/category extraction, not PDP extraction, so no row is fabricated for them. No qualifying rows emitted.
